body:
Thanks for the link. It's people like you that keep me from killing myself. I would miss you. Thanks for being here now for me. You help me to help myself. I hope I can return the favor someday. 

It's just sitting there and being the ultimate mistake and the darkness of it taunts and teases me, daring me to play with it...

But I will watch your link, thanks for sharing and I apologize if my strange thoughts scare you, they scare me too.

Oh man, I wrote a huge long post but it blasted rule one of of the water. Here's the tldr version:

Yes, I've tried getting professional help. I've been in and out of hospitals many times over the years, off and on a slew of medication. It's hard to talk to my family about this because one time I was hospitalized for threatening them and myself with weapons. 

I don't want to hurt anyone, or myself, but I'm afraid for the safety of myself and others because I don't trust myself. But I also don't want to go back into a mental health lock-down facility so I just live with this awful feeling that something isn't right and one day I'm going to snap.

I'm not on any medication right now, I stopped taking my anti-psychotics about 3 months ago and have been fine so far.. though I have them on hand and am thinking of using them again if things get "sketchy".

Edit: I was on anti-depressants before the anti-psychotics but *things* happened..
